record.paper_title: Open Problems on Syzygies and Hilbert Functions
record.original_question: When the positions of potentially nonzero Betti numbers are restricted, describe the generators of the semigroup of Betti diagrams of graded finitely generated S-modules.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $S = k[x_1,\dots,x_n]$ be the standard graded polynomial ring over a field $k$. For a finitely generated graded $S$-module $M$, let $\beta_{i,j}(M) = \dim_k \mathrm{Tor}_i^S(M,k)_j$ denote its graded Betti numbers, and let $\beta(M) = (\beta_{i,j}(M))_{i,j}$ be its Betti diagram, viewed as an element of the free abelian monoid on positions $(i,j) \in \mathbb{Z}_{\geq 0} \times \mathbb{Z}$.

Fix a subset $P \subseteq \mathbb{Z}_{\geq 0} \times \mathbb{Z}$ of "allowed positions." Define
$$B_P = \{\beta(M) : M \text{ is a finitely generated graded } S\text{-module with } \beta_{i,j}(M) = 0 \text{ for all } (i,j) \notin P\}.$$
Then $B_P$ is a sub-semigroup of $\mathbb{Z}_{\geq 0}^{P}$ under addition (since direct sums add Betti diagrams).

Problem: For natural choices of restriction set $P$ on the positions where Betti numbers are allowed to be nonzero, describe an explicit set of generators of the semigroup $B_P$.
artifact.status_search_result: The semigroup of Betti diagrams has been studied (e.g., Eisenbud–Erman–Schreyer and subsequent work), and it is known to be finitely generated in some cases, but a general explicit description of generators when positions of nonzero Betti numbers are restricted is not available in the literature. The problem appears to remain open in general.

status_evidence.title: The semigroup of Betti diagrams
status_evidence.snippet: Researchers have begun to expand on this new structure by investigating the semigroup of such diagrams, proving that this semigroup is finitely generated and answering several other fundamental questions about it.
status_evidence.claim: The semigroup of Betti diagrams is studied; finite generation results exist but a complete generator description in restricted-position settings is not given.

status_evidence.title: Boij-Söderberg theory: Introduction and survey
status_evidence.snippet: Survey of Boij–Söderberg theory and its open problems.
status_evidence.claim: Surveys on Boij-Söderberg theory list semigroup-of-Betti-diagrams questions among open directions.
